critical_code_review_comments: ms.run retries any exception once after logging in again, and that includes import_folder_link/import_link. On a -17 quota error the import is sent to MEGA twice, which is wasteful but harmless. If a big folder import times out after MEGA has accepted it, the retry can duplicate the folder. Consider not retrying imports, or retrying only on ESID/-15.

When the copy goes over quota, MEGA may accept the import and then put the account into over-quota (read-only/paywall) state. Users should know this; the warning text says 'MEGA app jaisa', which is fine.
The /search reply is cut with text[:4000]. With 30 long paths this can cut off the CREDIT or failed-account note. Minor.

/search runs through accounts one after another (each ms.run holds that account's lock and calls get_files). With many accounts it is slow. asyncio.gather would work because the locks are per account.
